name: I01 browser tab without an install event: the welcome screen offers Add to home screen and the sheet gives menu steps
I02 Chromium path: after beforeinstallprompt the sheet offers Install, prompt() is called once and Added is shown; appinstalled hides the card
I03 Chromium path, dismissed: a Not installed sheet, nothing else changes
I04 Not now closes the sheet and keeps the captured prompt for later
I05 link flag ?install=1 opens the sheet by itself, offers the dialog once the event arrives, and the flag is removed from the address
I06 link flag without an install event falls back to menu steps after a short wait
I07 iPhone in Safari: the sheet gives Share, then Add to Home Screen, and the storage note
I08 iPhone link flag: the Share steps open at once
I09 running from the home screen (display-mode standalone, Android): no install card, no iOS note, link flag ignored
I10 iPhone home-screen app (navigator.standalone) with no wallet: no install card, Safari storage note with the recovery route
I11 iPad (Mac user agent, MacIntel platform, five touch points) counts as iOS
I12 desktop browser without touch is not iOS and gets menu steps
I13 beforeinstallprompt fired before the app module loaded is still usable (captured by index.html)
